learnings.pattern: Browser validation catches lifecycle and stale-cache bugs that source contracts miss.
learnings.rule: Run static checks first, then a fresh-browser journey with console output and a saved fixture.

learnings.pattern: Whole-repository listener ratios are misleading for an app-lifetime composition root.
learnings.rule: Report raw census, file-level lifecycle coverage, named teardown contracts, and runtime limitations separately.

learnings.pattern: Injected browser dependencies must remain testable in Node.
learnings.rule: Use globalThis fallbacks and injected event targets; add a direct teardown contract test.

learnings.pattern: Large multiline patches create avoidable quoting and context failures.
learnings.rule: Patch one concern at a time and run the narrowest test immediately after each patch.

learnings.pattern: Documentation can drift even when code and tests are green.
learnings.rule: Run the documentation gate whenever a numbered status or round log changes.

learnings.pattern: PWA activation can interrupt active editor work.
learnings.rule: Never force a service-worker reload while text editing or a floating selection is active.
